title: Craft Presents
description: Are you celebrating a birthday? Need working presents for the Holidays? Craft presents and make your gift's special for them!
body:
# Craft Present's Datapack!
_This light weight datapack is made and optimized for multiplayer servers! But also works perfectly fine in singleplayer._

Are you celebrating a birthday? Need working presents for the Holidays?
Craft them yourself and gift them to your piers!
Just drop the items you want to gift on the ground and place your present!

Your friends can open with their bare hands or when opened with shears they can keep the packaging and use them as decoration!

_Crafting Recipe:_

_S=String P=Paper C=Chest_

_S P S_

_P C P = 8🎁_
